description: Bus- und Straßenbahnhaltestellen des Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreises is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten.en-kreis.de. Dieser Datensatz zeigt die Haltestellen des Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreises. Dabei sind sowohl Bus- als auch Straßenbahnhaltestellen enthalten und auch Haltestellen die aktuell von keiner Linie angefahren werden. Coverage: DE. Its keywords include Straßenbahnhaltestelle, Straßenbahnhaltestellen, Bushaltestellen, Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis, Bushaltestelle, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
